name_zh: 1956革命/欧尔班/后共转型：威权民粹与中欧枢纽外交
name_en: 1956 Revolution/Orban/Post-Communist Transition: Authoritarian Populism & Central European Pivot Diplomacy
description_zh: 匈牙利经历 1956 反苏起义/卡达尔软性共产主义/1989 圆桌会议/欧尔班 (1963-) 2010- 体制化威权民粹三重历史断层。欧尔班核心治理模式：宪法重写/司法捕获/媒体管制/学术自由压缩/反移民/反索罗斯/基督教民主/家庭政策→"非自由民主"宣言/中欧枢纽外交(维谢格拉德/中俄/欧盟/北约)→能源安全(帕克斯核电扩建/俄气/多元化)。体现 M161 后共转型/威权民粹——以"宪法重写+司法捕获+媒体管制+枢纽外交"四位一体，在欧盟/北约/中俄/维谢格拉德四强夹缝中构建主权自主空间。
description_en: Hungary across three historical ruptures: 1956 anti-Soviet uprising/Kadar goulash communism/1989 roundtable/Orban (1963-) 2010- institutionalized authoritarian populism. Orban's core governance model: constitutional rewrite/judicial capture/media control/academic freedom squeeze/anti-immigration/anti-Soros/Christian democracy/family policy -> 'illiberal democracy' declaration/Central European pivot diplomacy (Visegrad/China-Russia/EU/NATO) -> energy security (Paks nuclear expansion/Russian gas/diversification). Exemplifies M161 Post-Communist Transition/Authoritarian Populism—quaternity of 'constitutional rewrite + judicial capture + media control + pivot diplomacy' constructing sovereign autonomy space in EU/NATO/China-Russia/Visegrad four-power squeeze.
reason_zh: 匈牙利转型独特在于"威权民粹+基督教民主+枢纽外交"三位一体：欧尔班以民主选举合法性重写宪法捕获司法/媒体，以基督教身份拒移民/反全球主义，以维谢格拉德/中俄/欧盟/北约四面平衡争取能源/主权/资金。M161 区隔于 M170 威权稳定(白俄罗斯)、M163 斯拉夫边境(乌克兰)、M171 资源民族主义(伊拉克)，核心在于"选举威权+身份政治+多极平衡"的中欧特色范式。
reason_en: Hungarian transition unique in trinity of 'authoritarian populism + Christian democracy + pivot diplomacy': Orban uses democratic legitimacy to rewrite constitution capturing judiciary/media, Christian identity rejects immigration/globalism, Visegrad/China-Russia/EU/NATO four-way balancing for energy/sovereignty/funds. M161 distinct from M170 Authoritarian Stability (Belarus), M163 Slavic Borderland (Ukraine), M171 Resource Nationalist (Iraq), core: 'electoral authoritarianism + identity politics + multipolar balancing' Central European paradigm.
steps_zh: 1956 反苏起义精神锚定：纳吉改革/苏军镇压/卡达尔妥协，1956 成民族抵抗精神图腾
1989 圆桌会议体制转型：多党制/自由选举/私有化/北约/欧盟，西向锚定但保留社会福利
欧尔班体制化威权：2010 超级多数/2011 新宪法/司法退休年龄降低/媒体委员会/学术自由法/NGO 法/反移民围墙
"非自由民主"宣言与身份政治：2014 演讲定调/基督教民主/家庭政策/反索罗斯/反LGBT/反移民，身份政治凝聚核心选民
中欧枢纽外交四面平衡：维谢格拉德四国/俄帕克斯核电/中一带一路/欧盟结构性基金/北约成员，四强夹缝求生存
steps_en: 1956 anti-Soviet uprising spiritual anchor: Nagy reforms/Soviet crackdown/Kadar compromise, 1956 becomes national resistance spiritual totem
1989 roundtable systemic transition: multi-party/free elections/privatization/NATO/EU, Western anchoring but retaining social welfare
Orban institutionalized authoritarianism: 2010 supermajority/2011 new constitution/judicial retirement age lowered/media authority/academic freedom law/NGO law/anti-immigration fence
"Illiberal democracy" declaration & identity politics: 2014 speech sets tone/Christian democracy/family policy/anti-Soros/anti-LGBT/anti-immigration, identity politics consolidates core voters
Central European pivot diplomacy four-way balance: Visegrad Four/Russian Paks nuclear/Chinese BRI/EU structural funds/NATO member, four-power squeeze survival
expected_zh: 以"选举威权+身份政治+多极平衡"三位一体，在欧盟/北约/中俄/维谢格拉德四强夹缝中实现主权自主与能源安全，为中欧后共体制提供特色转型范式。
expected_en: Trinity of 'electoral authoritarianism + identity politics + multipolar balancing' achieves sovereign autonomy & energy security in EU/NATO/China-Russia/Visegrad four-power squeeze, providing characteristic transition paradigm for post-communist Central Europe.
case_zh: 1956 起义→1989 圆桌→1999 北约→2004 欧盟→2010 欧尔班上台→2011 新宪法→2015 移民围墙→2020s 非自由民主/帕克斯核电/维谢格拉德领袖，三重断层下的特色转型。
case_en: 1956 uprising -> 1989 roundtable -> 1999 NATO -> 2004 EU -> 2010 Orban power -> 2011 new constitution -> 2015 migrant fence -> 2020s illiberal democracy/Paks nuclear/Visegrad leader, characteristic transition under triple rupture.
intellectual_tradition: Hungarian Authoritarian Populism / Christian Democracy / Pivot Diplomacy
cross_cultural_impact: Illiberal democracy model; Christian democratic populism; Central European pivot diplomacy; energy sovereignty
diaspora_influence: Hungarian diaspora 5M+ (US/CA/DE/RO/RS/SK/AT); 1956 refugees shaped Cold War narratives
resource_curse_mitigation: No resource curse; automotive/pharma/IT/services; Russian gas dependency managed via Paks nuclear
